author: d. v. patel
title: Florida State women's golf to compete in ACC Championship starting Thursday - Tallahassee Sun
text:
The No. 16 Florida State women’s golf team will begin play at the 2026 Atlantic Coast Conference (ACC) Championship on Thursday, April 15, at Porters Neck Country Club in Wilmington, North Carolina.
The tournament is important for the Seminoles as they enter postseason play as the defending ACC champions. Returning players Sophia Fullbrook and Alexandra Gazzoli were part of last year’s winning squad. This spring, Florida State has won two tournaments and finished second twice.
Seeding for this year’s championship was determined by each team’s Scoreboard ranking as of April 9. The Seminoles are seeded fifth and will start at 7:45 a.m. from the 10th hole, paired with fourth-seeded North Carolina and sixth-seeded Southern Methodist University (SMU).
Fullbrook led Florida State with consecutive victories to close out the regular season and was named ACC Co-Golfer of the Month. The first and second rounds of stroke play are scheduled for Thursday, followed by a final round beginning at 8 a.m. on Friday. The top six teams after stroke play will advance to match play starting Saturday morning.
Other teams competing include Stanford (No.1), Wake Forest (No.9), Duke (No.11), North Carolina (No.12), SMU, Virginia, Virginia Tech, California, Clemson, NC State, Boston College, Miami, Louisville and Notre Dame.
For more information about Florida State women’s golf activities or updates during the championship event, fans can visit their Instagram (@fsuwomensgolf), X (@FSUGolf) or Facebook page (@FSUwomensGolf).
